name: Wikipedia search and scroll
intro: Welcome. We will find and read a public article in a short browser walkthrough.

steps.title: Type Ada Lovelace in Wikipedia
steps.say: I move to Wikipedia's search field and type Ada Lovelace. The matching article appears below the field.

steps.title: Click the Ada Lovelace result
steps.say: I click the result in the search suggestions and check the article heading.

steps.title: Scroll through the article
steps.say: I scroll down through the article at a readable pace.

steps.title: Close the walkthrough window
steps.say: I close the rehearsal window after reading the article.

description: Search Wikipedia, click the real article, scroll and close the rehearsal window.
